verdict.rationale: Bulk operations are a fair question for an ATS, but the evidence never documents acting on many items at once. Ashby Assistant can 'update candidates' and 'take action across Ashby', but nothing shows these actions apply in batch. AI rediscovery scans candidates to surface matches, which is search rather than a bulk action, and API pagination and sync tokens are only developer building blocks for listing records.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
